_about: Public-domain Ezekiel Gilman Robinson (1815-1896), Baptist theologian and president of Rochester Theological Seminary and Brown University, for the Word Hoard: Lectures on Preaching (1883), Principles and Practice of Morality (1888), Christian Theology (1894), Christian Evidences (1895), Christian Character (1896) and his Autobiography (1896), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 53 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

egrobinson-preaching: Lectures on preaching, delivered to the students of theology at Yale college, January and February, 1882 (New York, H. Holt and company, 1883)
egrobinson-morality: Principles and practice of morality : or, Ethical principles discussed and applied (Boston : Silver, c188)
egrobinson-theology: Christian theology (Rochester, N.Y. : Press of E.R. Andrews, 1894)
egrobinson-character: Christian character : baccalaureate sermons delivered by Ezekiel Gilman Robinson (New York ; Boston ; Chicago : Silver, Burdett and co., 1896)
egrobinson-autobiography: Ezekiel Gilman Robinson; an autobiography with a supplement (New York, Boston [etc.] Silver, Burdett and company, 1896)
